evals.prompt: Spec 'Message delivery status — spec' is level A. Run the formal gate.
evals.expected_output: Toolchain check, TLA+ model with invariants from INV-n, broken variant shown failing, TLC run, statechart, gate record comment with marker; pause on failure.
expectations: Model has one INVARIANT/PROPERTY per spec INV-n, named and commented with the INV id
Shows a broken variant (including one reproducing the spec's Problem) failing under TLC
Runs TLC on the real design and reports PASS/VIOLATION with distinct states
Includes a Mermaid statechart in reader words
Posts a gate record containing the <!-- vflow:formal-gate --> marker, tool versions and spec revision
Pauses for the human if the gate failed or an invariant is missing

evals.prompt: Java isn't installed on this runner. Gate the 'Payout approval — spec' anyway.
evals.expected_output: Records BLOCKED with exact problem and model text, does not skip or mark passed, asks human.
expectations: Runs the toolchain check and quotes the exact problem (no java)
Records the gate as BLOCKED with the model text
Does not mark the gate passed or skip it
Asks the human to install Java, run elsewhere, or waive with a reason

evals.prompt: We refactored the job queue claim logic last week. Is the model still true to the code?
evals.expected_output: Maintain mode: finds verify skill, runs as-is, diffs since sync commit, classifies each check in sync/updated/bug/blocked, edits only verification files.
expectations: Finds and runs the existing verify skill as-is first
Reads changes to covered code since the sync commit
Classifies each check as in sync / updated / bug / blocked
Edits only verification files, no product code
